title: Bakewell tart
hookLine: British-inspired bakewell tart with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Bakewell tart
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the pastry, measure the flour into a bowl and rub in the butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs. Add the water, mixing to form a soft dough. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured work surface and use to line a 20cm/8in flan tin. Leave in the fridge to chill for 30 minutes. Incorporate {m52767_1}, {m52767_2}, {m52767_3}, and {m52767_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Bakewell tart
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 200C/400F/Gas 6 (180C fan). Line the pastry case with foil and fill with baking beans. Bake blind for about 15 minutes, then remove the beans and foil and cook for a further five minutes to dry out the base. Incorporate {m52767_5}, {m52767_6}, {m52767_7}, {m52767_8}, {m52767_9}, and {m52767_10} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Bakewell tart
steps.instructionTemplate: For the filing, spread the base of the flan generously with raspberry jam. Melt the butter in a pan, take off the heat and then stir in the sugar. Add ground almonds, egg and almond extract. Pour into the flan tin and sprinkle over the flaked almonds.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Bakewell tart
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for about 35 minutes. If the almonds seem to be browning too quickly, cover the tart loosely with foil to prevent them burning.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
